notify.restart_needed: Harmonia was turned off. Text translated so far stays until the game restarts.
hero.off_text: Turn on one of your translations below.
hero.off_empty_text: Add a translation to get started.
hero.turns_on_text: {0} turns on the next time you start the game.
hero.reloaded_text: Harmonia was reloaded while the game was running. Translation comes back after a game restart.
banner.restart: Restart the game to apply your changes.
banner.switch: {0} will be used from the next game start.
banner.turns_off: Translation turns off the next time you start the game.
notice.penumbra: Some characters in window titles, tabs, and on the title screen show as dashes: those game fonts don't have them. Harmonia adds the missing characters through the Penumbra plugin. Install and enable Penumbra, then restart the game. The rest of the translation works without it.
notice.fonts_reload: Some characters in window titles, tabs, and on the title screen still show as dashes: the game didn't reload its fonts. Open Penumbra → Settings → Advanced and press Reload Fonts. Harmonia can't do this by itself in this game version yet.
translations.title: Your translations
translations.empty_text: Get a link or a file from the translation's author and add it here.
card.turns_on: Turns on after a game restart
card.turns_off: Turns off after a game restart
card.updated_restart: New version after a game restart
card.restart_hint: Takes effect the next time you start the game.
card.invalid: This translation is damaged and can't be used.
card.wrong_language: Made for the game in {0}, but your game is in {1}.
card.old_plugin: Needs a newer Harmonia ({0} or later). Update the plugin.
card.game_drift: Made for another version of the game. Text that changed since then stays in the original language until the translation is updated.
feed.incompatible: no version for this game yet
feed.incompatible_long: There is no version of this translation for your game yet.
feed.plugin_too_old_long: The newest version of this translation needs a newer Harmonia. Update Harmonia in /xlplugins.
details.setup_text: Paste the update link from the translation's author (usually next to the download). Harmonia will check it for new versions.
details.stop_updates_hint: Harmonia stops checking this link. The installed translation stays.
add.title: Add a translation
add.link_text: Paste the link from the translation's author. Harmonia installs the translation and keeps it up to date.
add.file_text: If you have a translation file (.hpk), choose it on your computer.
updates.invalid_url: This doesn't look like a link. It must start with https://
link.not_found: Nothing was found at this link. Check that it was copied completely.
link.server_error: The server behind this link returned an error ({0}). Try again later.
link.unreachable: Couldn't open this link. Check the address and your internet connection.
link.timeout: The server didn't respond in time. Try again later.
link.not_feed: This link doesn't lead to a Harmonia translation. Ask the author for the update link.
link.bad_download: The downloaded file is damaged or doesn't match the link. Try again later.
link.other_pack: This link is for another translation: {0}.
import.done_turns_on: {0} is installed and turns on the next time you start the game.
trust.title: Check the author
trust.first_use: {0} comes from an author Harmonia doesn't know yet. Harmonia will remember the author's key and accept updates only with it.
trust.compare: If the author published their key (for example, on their website or Discord), make sure it matches:
trust.key_changed: {0} is signed with a different key than before. Authors sometimes change keys, but this can also mean someone else made the file. Install it only if the author announced the new key.
trust.unsigned: {0} isn't signed, so there's no way to tell who made it. Install it only if you made it yourself or fully trust where it came from.
trust.downgrade: This is an older version ({0}) than the one you have ({1}).
updates.error_unsigned: This version isn't signed, so it can't be installed from the link.
updates.error_key_changed: This version is signed with a different key than before, so it isn't installed. If the author announced a new key, download the file and add it: it will appear as a separate translation.
updates.notify_installed: {0}: version {1} is installed. Restart the game to use it.
settings.auto_install_hint: New versions are downloaded and checked in the background and apply the next time you start the game.
settings.follow_testing_hint: Testing versions come out earlier but may have mistakes.
info.intro: If something doesn't work, copy this report and send it to the translation's author.
info.pack_not_usable: The translation isn't installed or doesn't fit this game.
info.engine_errors: running; {0} rows couldn't be processed and stay in the original
info.fonts_applied: added to {0} font sizes through Penumbra
info.fonts_no_penumbra: not added: Penumbra isn't installed or enabled
info.fonts_needs_reload: prepared, but the game wasn't asked to reload its fonts: this game version isn't recognized yet (use Reload Fonts in Penumbra)
info.fonts_skipped: Skipped because the game font changed or has no room: {0}
info.layout_mismatch: {0} game tables changed in this game version and stay untranslated.
info.counts_hint: The numbers grow as the game loads text. A line is translated only if the game text is exactly what the translator worked from.
restart.title: Harmonia
restart.heading: Restart the game
restart.message: Harmonia was reloaded while the game was running. So that the game's text is never half translated, translation stays off until you restart the game.
diagnostics.no_sheets: No sheet of the pack was loaded yet.
